description: Leave a review of a sitter for a finished Juggle booking: a 0–5 star rating in half stars, plus optional comments. The sitter and other families can see it and there is no edit or delete tool. booking_id from juggle_list_bookings (status completed / awaiting review / awaiting payment); sitter_account_id is the booked sitter's accountId from juggle_get_booking. Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

name: juggle_leave_review
